_evidence: 0x0054dedb removes the newlines of the text-edit buffer: esi = [edi] text, lodsb until NUL; at each 0x0a it calls 0x54e13f (delete at edx, eax = 1) and pulls the cursor [edi+8] back when it lies after the newline. 0x54e13f only deletes before the end pointer [edi+4], so a newline at or past the end would be found forever: in every valid state the end pointer lies past the text. Record: text at the fixed unused bss block 0xa20000 (64 chars from newline/letters/space, NUL at 0xa20040), end pointer 0xa20040..0xa20048, cursor 0..80 into the text.
